text:
incident-bot: [PAGE] SEV2 — automated evals detect regression for tenant acme-enterprise-vpc (dedicated pool: x-pool-04). Eval drift >30% vs baseline on model open-alpha-3b (quant profile change suspected). Alert rules: quality-drop >20% and traffic >100rps.

eva_oncall: taking this. oncall runbook step 1: confirm customer impact and isolate scope. @carla_acct can you confirm which product flows are affected for Acme?

carla_acct: @eva_oncall hi — customer reported noisy hallucinations in our anomaly detection assistant earlier. Impacting internal alerts (not billing pipeline). They're on dedicated VPC with reserved pool x-pool-04. Please keep me in the loop; I'll prep comms.

alice_sre: oncall handoff from eva noted. tagging infra + ml. first quick checks: 1) is this tenancy-limited? 2) did a model/quant roll hit that pool recently?

ben_infra: checking deploy history for x-pool-04... found model-policy daemon rolled a quantization profile change at 2024-11-29T06:12:08Z — changed open-alpha-3b from q4_0 -> q3_1 to save memory. Rollout targeted dedicated pools flagged performance-tier=single-tenant. I have the deploy ID: deploy-20241129-612.

dmitri_ml: that matches the time evals first tripped. Quick analysis: our automated evals (prompt set acme_regress_check) show answer_quality dropped from 0.72 -> 0.41 after the quant switch for open-alpha-3b. Sample diffs attached below.

dmitri_ml: sample before:
```
Q: "Why did server restart at 03:14?"
A (baseline q4_0): "Restart due to oom in process X; recommended check memory events and restart policy."
score: 0.78
```

dmitri_ml: sample after:
```
Q: "Why did server restart at 03:14?"
A (q3_1): "It restarted because something happened. Check logs."
score: 0.33
```

eva_oncall: so root cause likely quant profile regress. Because this is single tenant (acme-enterprise-vpc) on a dedicated pool, we can attempt a tenant-scoped mitigation (do not need global rollback). Options:
- revert quant profile for only acme's allocation in x-pool-04 (preferred)
- pin acme to previous model variant (open-alpha-3b@q4_0) via tenant override
- divert traffic to fallback model (open-alpha-3b-float or larger model) — higher cost

alice_sre: agree prefer targeted revert. Ben, can we patch pool allocation for tenant to force previous quant profile? what's the safest path?

ben_infra: yes — we have a tenant override API for Dedicated pools. We can create an override object that sets model_variant = "open-alpha-3b:q4_0" for tenant acme-enterprise-vpc and apply to pool x-pool-04. That change is atomic and affects only the tenant. Will require rolling workers to pick up change; we can trigger refresh on the shard(s) serving acme.

ben_infra: plan to run (dry-run first):
```
# dry-run
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/pools/x-pool-04/tenants/acme-enterprise-vpc/overrides:preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_variant":"open-alpha-3b:q4_0"}'

# apply
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/pools/x-pool-04/tenants/acme-enterprise-vpc/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_variant":"open-alpha-3b:q4_0","reason":"incident-1727654321 revert quant profile"}'
```

dmitri_ml: after apply, we should run targeted evals and compare. If quality returns to baseline, keep override until policy change is reverted upstream. Also create a canary that routes 10% of acme traffic to q4_0 first to validate.

eva_oncall: ETA for dry-run? and who will execute apply if preview looks good?

ben_infra: I can run the preview in 5m. If it matches expected diff I'll ask @alice_sre to approve apply (separation of duties).

alice_sre: copy. I can approve apply once we have preview logs and no infra regressions expected. I'll be at my laptop for the next hour.

carla_acct: I need a short impact summary for Acme (one paragraph) once we confirm mitigation. They want timeline + workaround. Also confirm if any data exposure or config changes required on their side (should be none).

incident-bot: ACTION LOG — incident created 1727654321, severity SEV2, assigned: eva_oncall, watchers: alice_sre, ben_infra, dmitri_ml, carla_acct.

ben_infra: preview results: override preview shows cost/delta: cpu mem N/A, model loaded with q4_0 candidate. No errors in compatibility checks. Sample inference local-run with override shows sample score 0.76 (matches baseline). Logs:
```
2024-11-29T07:02:11Z preview-ok tenant=acme-enterprise-vpc model=open-alpha-3b:q4_0 score=0.76
```

dmitri_ml: nice. I'd still recommend canary 10% for 15 minutes before 100% flip. That lets us assert both correctness and perf metrics (latency, memory).

eva_oncall: agreed. Plan: 0) ben runs apply with canary=10% 1) run eval set every 2m 2) if metrics stable after 15m, increase to 100% 3) if regression persists, fallback to divert traffic to float variant and open escalation.

ben_infra: executing apply (canary=10%) now. patch id patch-1727654321-a. I'll post logs when workers pick it up.

ben_infra: worker pickup log:
```
2024-11-29T07:10:24Z worker-14 pickup-override tenant=acme model=open-alpha-3b:q4_0 canary=10%
```

dmitri_ml: running evals... current rolling metrics (canary=10%):
- answer_quality: 0.73 (canary) vs 0.42 (baseline q3_1)
- latency p95: 210ms (canary) vs 200ms (q3_1)
Looks good for quality; small latency bump expected.

alice_sre: after 15m of canary with no new errors and improvements in quality, I approve moving to 100%. ben please proceed and monitor.

ben_infra: promoting to 100% for tenant override... applied patch-1727654321-b. worker logs show full rollout at 07:28:51Z.

ben_infra: post-rollout eval snapshot:
```
2024-11-29T07:29:00Z tenant=acme answer_quality=0.74 latency_p95=215ms
```

eva_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. Oncall tasks:
- keep tenant override in place until ML owns a permanent revert/QA (dmitri/ml owner)
- create Jira to revert the global quant-policy change or re-run that rollout after additional evals with new profile
- prepare customer-facing summary (carla)

dmitri_ml: I'll open ML ticket ML-8272 to investigate quant q3_1 anomalies and run broader evals across other tenants. Proposed owner: dmitri_ml.

carla_acct: drafting message to Acme:
"We detected a model quality regression in a recent performance optimization we rolled to your dedicated pool. We applied a tenant-scoped rollback and your assistant is now back to expected response quality. We're investigating the root cause and will keep you updated; no action required on your side." Will send after you confirm.

alice_sre: confirm no customer data exposure, no secrets rotated. Incident complete from SRE side. Keep this thread open for ML follow-up and Jira links.

incident-bot: incident update: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned -> dmitri_ml for root-cause and rollback ticket ML-8272.

carla_acct: thanks everyone. I'll send the note in 10m and offer a follow-up call if they want deeper details.

eva_oncall: handing off to alice_sre for on-call shadowing; I'm going to grab the after-action items into the incident board.

alice_sre: acknowledged handoff. Logged postmortem stub: "tenant-scoped quantization rollback for acme-enterprise-vpc after q3_1 profile caused quality regression; immediate mitigation: tenant override to q4_0; follow-ups: ML root cause, rollout gating improvements." Will complete full postmortem in 48h.

dmitri_ml: adding note: recommend adding preflight eval gating for quant profile changes and a 'tenant-sampled' smoke test for dedicated pools.

ben_infra: I'll keep audit logs and apply artifacts attached to Jira.

incident-bot: closing note: last_message_ts=1727657921. If further regressions occur, re-open ticket or ping @oncall.
